title: Benchmarking histopathology foundation models in a multi-center dataset for skin cancer subtyping

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the leakage of center-related information (scanner shifts) in extracted feature representations using a novel metric called the Foundation Model - Silhouette Index (FM-SI), and comparing it with the Robustness Index (RI) to evaluate how much the data clusters by acquisition hospital rather than by biological class.
